haven_compat.portals.shaders_off: Shaders are on, but this computer's OpenGL cannot run Immersive Portals' shader path and Haven Compat could not patch it. Portals still teleport but show as empty frames until shaders are off.
haven_compat.settings.title: Haven Compat
haven_compat.settings.portal_view.disabl: Portals show a purple plane and do not render the world behind them. This can raise FPS a lot. Teleporting still works.
haven_compat.settings.player_animation_d: Player animations from resource packs read only the player data they use (off hand, held item, flying, sleeping). This can raise FPS a lot with Fresh Animations.
Player animations from resource packs read all player data, including the whole inventory. Use this if a pack needs other player data.
